caption.text: Part 2 of REDIS STREAMS & PUB/SUB. `PUBLISH` returning 2 does not mean two workers did the job — it means two sockets got the bytes, and Redis stopped caring. This ten-page field handbook walks the whole Redis messaging surface: why Pub/Sub loses messages six different ways, how consumer groups split work with XREADGROUP and the Pending Entries List, and how to rescue stuck entries with XAUTOCLAIM before your trim policy deletes work nobody ran. Save it before your next queue outage, not after.
